title: Treatment Room Reset
summary: How to prepare the room between guests.

steps.title: Refresh linens
steps.body: Replace used towels and sheets with clean, warm sets.

steps.title: Restock products
steps.body: Check oils, creams, and amenity trays before the next guest.

steps.title: Set the mood
steps.body: Adjust lighting, scent, music, and temperature.

remember: A ready room is part of the welcome.
